answer: Garnet default calibration set edea61a8-0087-446a-836a-66ff46ee5413. The pair with the highest IRB CZ fidelity is QB12-QB17, at 0.99878 (uncertainty 0.00037). QB12-QB7 is a very close second at 0.99878. I ran a Bell circuit (H, CNOT, measure both) on garnet:mock with 100 shots, pinned to physical qubits QB12 and QB17 (indices 11 and 16). I checked the transpiled circuit: the r and cz gates and both measurements sit on those two qubits only. Counts: 00:52, 11:48. The mock output is not a real hardware result. One caution: I submitted three mock jobs in total. The first two came from runs of the same script, and a third run was needed to see its output. I did not capture the ID of the middle job, so job_ids lists only the first and the final job, and the final job is last. All three used the same pinned qubits and 100 shots. All were free mock jobs, so credits used were 0.
